comparison.objective: Recover drawer opening after a clothing obstruction; candidate performs tooling preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handle control, obstruction compression, and resumed prismatic motion versus small-part alignment and snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Ordered jam, compression, clearance, and stable full opening versus collet retention after release.
comparison.reason: The drawer record has no separate spec versions, but its complete body supplies the rubric. It tests conditional recovery, not component assembly.
